title: A beggar: sharp eyes in the dark, timid, does not run to the guards
note: SANDBOX (by design: broad and diverse profiles, each with traits). Traits 0 to 1; SightRange in metres (daylight, open ground, a running body), ConeDegrees the half-angle, NoticeSeconds, MakeOutSeconds, ConcludeSeconds (each step up the ladder), HoldSeconds and CoolDownSeconds (calming down) in seconds (the proposed values). Voice 0.2: a mutter heard 3 m off, not a cry for the watch.
